card.vocal_coaching.name: Vocal Coaching
card.vocal_coaching.headline.1: Another early session. The high notes are coming back.
card.vocal_coaching.headline.2: Scales again. Nobody photographs this part.
card.vocal_coaching.headline.3: Your coach doesn't praise you. That's how you know it's working.
card.open_mic.name: Open Mic
card.open_mic.text: Gain 4 Hype and 1 Capital. Gain 2 Heat.
card.open_mic.headline.1: LOCAL CROWD FALLS SILENT FOR NEWCOMER
card.open_mic.headline.2: OPEN MIC REGULARS: "WE SAW THEM FIRST"
card.viral_stunt.name: Viral Stunt
card.press_junket.name: Press Junket
card.press_junket.text: Craft 20+: gain 7 Hype, 1 Heat. Otherwise: gain 4 Hype, 4 Heat.
card.press_junket.headline.1: ON THE RECORD: RISING SINGER TALKS FAME AND FAMILY
card.side_gig.name: Side Gig
card.side_gig.headline.1: A wedding band, Saturday. It covers the rent.
card.side_gig.headline.2: Backing vocals on someone else's song. Cash, no credit.
card.lay_low.name: Lay Low
card.lay_low.headline.1: A quiet week, on purpose. The phone buzzes; you let it.
card.lay_low.headline.2: You stay in. Let someone else be the story.
card.networking.name: Networking
card.networking.headline.1: A party you weren't quite invited to. You leave with six new numbers.
card.networking.headline.2: Drinks with people who know people.
card.crisis_pr.name: Crisis PR
card.crisis_pr.text: Needs a Scandal and 4 Capital. Pay 4 Capital: remove a Scandal for good.
card.crisis_pr.headline.1: A publicist makes some calls. By morning, a different story is trending.
card.studio_session.name: Studio Session
card.studio_session.headline.1: Eleven takes of the same line. The eleventh was the one.
card.studio_session.headline.2: A long night in the studio, with nothing to show for it yet.
card.tabloid_story.name: The Breakup Story
card.tabloid_story.text: Every interview now starts with the same question.
card.tabloid_story.headline: EXCLUSIVE: THE SPLIT THEY TRIED TO KEEP QUIET
card.public_feud.name: The Feud
card.public_feud.headline: WAR OF WORDS: NEWCOMER FIRES BACK AT RIVAL
card.ghostwriter.name: Ghostwriter
card.ghostwriter.text: Needs 3 Capital. Pay 3 Capital: gain 7 Craft.
card.ghostwriter.headline.1: Someone else writes the bridge. Your name goes on it.
card.ghostwriter.headline.2: The best line on the record isn't yours. It was expensive.
card.meditation_retreat.name: Meditation Retreat
card.meditation_retreat.text: Needs 10 Craft. Lose 4 Craft: lose 8 Heat.
card.meditation_retreat.headline.1: You switch your phone off for a weekend. The world keeps turning.
card.apology_tour.name: Apology Tour
card.apology_tour.text: Needs a Scandal. Lose 6 Hype: remove a Scandal for good.
card.apology_tour.headline.1: THE APOLOGY: SINGER FACES THE CAMERAS
card.collab_single.name: Collab Single
card.collab_single.text: Signed: gain 9 Hype and 2 Capital. Otherwise: gain 4 Hype, 2 Heat.
card.tabloid_bait.name: Tabloid Bait
card.tabloid_bait.text: 2+ Scandals: gain 10 Hype, 4 Heat. Otherwise: gain 3 Hype, 2 Heat.
card.tabloid_bait.headline.1: SINGER BREAKS SILENCE — AND IT'S EVERYWHERE BY LUNCH
card.tabloid_bait.headline.2: SINGER FEEDS THE PAPERS A STORY — AND THEY BITE
card.reinvent_image.name: Reinvent Your Image
card.reinvent_image.text: Remove a Stunt card for good. Lose 6 Heat and 2 Hype.
card.reinvent_image.headline.1: NEW LOOK, NEW SOUND: THE BIG REINVENTION
card.sellout_ad.name: Sellout Ad
card.sellout_ad.text: Gain 6 Capital. Lose 3 Craft. Gain 1 Heat.
card.sellout_ad.headline.1: You sing about yoghurt for thirty seconds. The money is extremely real.
card.street_team.name: Street Team
card.street_team.text: Needs 2 Capital. Pay 2 Capital: gain 5 Hype, draw 1.
card.street_team.headline.1: POSTERS APPEAR OVERNIGHT: WHO IS THIS SINGER?
card.street_team.headline.2: THE NAME ON EVERY LAMPPOST IN TOWN
card.demo_tape.name: Demo Tape
card.demo_tape.text: Needs 15 Craft. Add a Studio Session to your discard pile. Gain 2 Craft.
card.demo_tape.headline.1: You finish a demo worth sending. A studio says: come in next week.
card.demo_tape.headline.2: Four songs on a drive. Enough to get you back in the booth.
card.fan_meetup.name: Fan Meetup
card.fan_meetup.text: Went viral: gain 6 Hype and 2 Capital. Otherwise: gain 3 Hype and 1 Capital.
card.fan_meetup.headline.1: FANS QUEUE FOR HOURS TO MEET NEW FAVOURITE
card.late_night_show.name: Late Night Show
card.late_night_show.text: Needs 25 Hype. Gain 8 Hype, 3 Heat. Craft 30+: lose 3 Heat.
card.late_night_show.headline.1: LATE-NIGHT DEBUT: NEWCOMER STEALS THE SHOW
card.cover_single.name: Cover Single
card.cover_single.text: Gain 1 Capital and 2 Heat. Craft 15+: gain 5 Hype. Otherwise: gain 3 Hype.
card.cover_single.headline.1: FANS SAY THE COVER BEATS THE ORIGINAL
card.brand_deal.name: Brand Deal
card.brand_deal.text: Opportunity. Needs 20 Hype. Gain 7 Capital, 2 Heat.
card.brand_deal.headline.1: The contract's signed. Your face is on the side of a bus.
card.film_cameo.name: Film Cameo
card.film_cameo.text: Opportunity. Needs 35 Hype. Gain 12 Hype, 2 Craft, 4 Heat.
card.mentorship.name: Mentorship
card.mentorship.headline.1: An older singer takes you aside and tells you what no one else will.
card.world_tour.name: World Tour
card.world_tour.text: Opportunity. Needs 5 Capital. Pay 5 Capital: gain 16 Hype, 6 Heat.
card.world_tour.headline.1: WORLD TOUR ANNOUNCED — FIRST DATES ALREADY GONE
card.award_campaign.name: Award Campaign
card.award_campaign.text: Opportunity. Needs 40 Craft. Gain 7 Hype. Lose 2 Heat.
card.award_campaign.headline.1: CRITICS RALLY BEHIND THE YEAR'S MOST UNDERRATED VOICE
card.legal_team.name: Legal Team
card.legal_team.text: Opportunity. Needs a Scandal and 6 Capital. Pay 6 Capital: remove 2 Scandals for good.
card.legal_team.headline.1: The lawyers send letters. Two stories quietly disappear.
card.indie_label.name: Indie Label
card.indie_label.text: Opportunity. Needs 40 Hype and 4 Capital, and no deal yet. Pay 4 Capital: you're signed.
card.indie_label.headline.1: SIGNED: SMALL LABEL BETS ON NEWCOMER
card.bad_press.name: The Review
card.bad_press.text: Someone quotes it at you. Again.
card.bad_press.headline: CRITICS: OVERHYPED AND UNDERCOOKED
card.burnout.name: Burnout
card.burnout.text: You're tired in a way sleep doesn't fix.
card.burnout.headline: SHOWS CANCELLED: "EXHAUSTION," SAYS SINGER'S CAMP
card.copycat_story.name: Everyone's Running It
card.copycat_story.text: It keeps getting repeated. It keeps getting worse.
card.copycat_story.headline: NOW EVERY OUTLET HAS THE STORY
card.old_rumor.name: Cash Grab
card.old_rumor.text: Every post about you has the same comment under it.
card.old_rumor.headline: CASH GRAB? FANS TURN ON SINGER OVER BRAND DEALS
gate.audition.name: Open Audition
gate.audition.flavor: A real panel, a real audition. They don't care how many followers you have.
gate.showcase.name: Industry Showcase
gate.showcase.flavor: An industry showcase. Half the room came to be seen. You need to be seen more.
gate.festival.name: Festival Slot
gate.festival.flavor: A summer festival, second stage, mid-afternoon. Win over a crowd that came for someone else.
gate.session_work.name: Session Work
gate.session_work.flavor: Backing vocals on a major record. Pure craft. Nobody will ever know it was you.
gate.label_deal.name: Label Deal
gate.label_deal.flavor: A label wants a meeting. What they really want is proof you're a sure thing.
gate.residency.name: Club Residency
gate.residency.flavor: A weekly slot at a serious venue. They'll check your reputation before your setlist.
gate.arena_tour.name: Arena Tour
gate.arena_tour.flavor: A support slot on an arena tour — only for acts with a label behind them.
gate.award_show.name: Award Show
gate.award_show.flavor: A nomination, if the committee trusts you not to embarrass them on the night.
act.spring.name: Spring
act.spring.opener: Nobody knows your name yet. Enjoy it. It's the last time you'll have nothing to lose.
act.summer.name: Summer
act.summer.opener: Things are moving fast now. The choices you make this season have a way of following you.
act.autumn.name: Autumn
act.autumn.opener: The weather turns. So does the coverage. Whatever you did in summer, someone wrote it down.
act.winter.name: Winter
act.winter.opener: Awards season. The industry sits down to decide what you are. You'll carry everything you've done into that room.
ending.meltdown.name: Cautionary Tale
ending.meltdown.goal: Be everywhere, for all the wrong reasons.
ending.meltdown.text: By winter the story had stopped being about the music. It was about the feud, the photos, the apology, the apology for the apology. You were everywhere — that was the problem. Somewhere, a younger singer is being told about you as a warning, and the worst part is that most of what they're hearing is true. Still. You got what you wanted. Everyone knows your name.
ending.star.name: Headliner
ending.star.goal: Get famous, get signed, and keep your past from catching up with you.
ending.star.text: Your name is on the poster now, big enough to read from across the street. Strangers sing your chorus back at you — slightly wrong — and you let them. There were nights this year you'd rather not explain, and some of them are still out there, filed away somewhere, waiting. But tonight the room is full, and everyone in it came for you. Nobody gets to keep this. You get to have it.
ending.craftsman.name: The Musician's Musician
ending.craftsman.goal: Be genuinely great, and known just enough to be taken seriously.
ending.craftsman.text: You won't be recognised in the supermarket. You'll be recognised in studios, by people who know exactly how hard the thing you just did was. Session players ask how you phrased that bridge. A producer you've admired for years sends a message that says only: again? It isn't fame, and some nights you wonder if it's enough. But it's the kind of reputation that outlasts fame.
ending.nobody.name: Nobody Yet
ending.nobody.goal: What happens if the year gets away from you.
ending.nobody.text: The year ends quietly. No headlines, good or bad. You're still singing, mostly to rooms that aren't paying attention, and some mornings that feels like failure and some mornings it feels like the most honest thing you've done. Most people who come to this city don't last a year. You did. There's no rule that says it has to happen now.
story.opening:
Spring.

You have a demo recorded in a friend's bedroom, a coat that isn't quite warm enough, and a phone that doesn't ring.

Everyone in this city wants to be seen. That's the easy part. The trouble is, once people start looking, they don't stop.

You have one year.
award.best_new_artist.name: Best New Artist
award.best_new_artist.citation: For a debut year that made the rest of the industry feel slow.
award.breakthrough_of_the_year.name: Breakthrough of the Year
award.breakthrough_of_the_year.citation: From nowhere to everywhere in twelve months.
award.peoples_choice.name: People's Choice
award.peoples_choice.citation: Voted for by the fans. All of them, apparently.
award.critics_choice.name: Critics' Choice
award.critics_choice.citation: The year's most overlooked voice. You may not have heard them. You should have.
award.comeback_of_the_year.name: Comeback of the Year
award.comeback_of_the_year.citation: For proving the second act can outshine the first — and that the first can be survived.
award.scandal_of_the_year.name: Scandal of the Year
award.scandal_of_the_year.citation: For services to the gossip pages. We couldn't have filled them without you.
